tools.name: king_county_permit_status
tools.description: Live building-permit history and status for any King County, WA address, parcel or permit number — 20 city systems, unincorporated King County, the Assessor's parcel index and WA L&I electrical, normalized to one schema with provenance (record_url, is_open, trust_level, next_step, cite_as). Read-only.
